notes.text: Every hero is now rated on Large Single Hits, so Mystic Reverb favours heroes with big individual spirit hits and Spellbreaker counts the enemies who land them.
Rat King, Solomon and Baba are rated; Warden, Venator, Apollo and Calico adjusted. Deadman Danny added, ratings still to come. Item stats refreshed.
New hero: Solomon. Its ratings are still to come, so recommendations leave it out until then.
New Large Single Hits rating, with rules for Mystic Reverb and Spellbreaker. Heroes aren't rated for it yet, so recommendations don't change until they are.
New Consistent Heavy Spirit Hits rating for every hero, ready for items that react to heavy spirit hits.
Heroes now have a Durability rating, measured from how much damage they take per match in Phantom+ games. Barrier and resist items, and Berserker, now scale with it instead of max HP.
New heroes: Rat King and Baba. Their ratings are still to come, so recommendations leave them out until then.
